import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 1000100;
    static final int OO = 1000000007;
    static final int M = 1000000007;
    static int n, d;
    static ArrayList<Long> v = new ArrayList<>();
    static Node[] md, hp;
    static Node ht;

    static class Node {
        long[][] dp = new long[64][64];
        long[][] cnt = new long[64][64];
        boolean[] mark = new boolean[64];
        boolean[] tark = new boolean[64];

        void mrg(Node nd) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                    cnt[i][j] = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k <= d; k++) {
                        cnt[i][j] = (cnt[i][j] + dp[k][j] * nd.dp[i][k]) % M;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                if (mark[i] && !nd.mark[i]) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                        cnt[i][j] = dp[i][j];
                    }
                }
                if (!mark[i] && nd.mark[i]) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                        cnt[j][i] = nd.dp[j][i];
                    }
                }
                mark[i] |= nd.mark[i];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                    dp[i][j] = cnt[i][j];
                }
            }
        }

        void clean() {
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                    dp[i][j] = cnt[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void shift(int x) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                    cnt[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) {
                    cnt[(i + x) % d][(j + x) % d] = dp[i][j];
                }
                cnt[(i + x) % d][d] = dp[i][d];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                cnt[d][(i + x) % d] = dp[d][i];
            }
            cnt[d][d] = dp[d][d];

            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                    dp[i][j] = cnt[i][j];
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                tark[i] = mark[(i + x) % d];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                mark[i] = tark[i];
            }
        }
    }

    static Node get(int x) {
        int h = x;
        int pw = 1;
        int t = -1;
        while (h >= d) {
            h /= d;
            pw *= d;
            t++;
        }
        x %= pw;
        if (t == -1) {
            return hp[h];
        }
        Node ans = md[t];
        ht = md[t];
        for (int i = 1; i < h; i++) {
            ht.shift(1);
            ans.mrg(ht);
        }
        ht = get(x);
        ht.shift(h);
        ans.mrg(ht);
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        n--;
        while (n > 0) {
            v.add((long)(n % d));
            n /= d;
        }
        int sizeV = v.size();

        hp = new Node[d + 1];
        md = new Node[sizeV + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
            hp[i] = new Node();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= sizeV; i++) {
            md[i] = new Node();
        }

        // Initialize hp[0]
        hp[0].dp[d][d] = 2;
        hp[0].dp[d][0] = -1;
        hp[0].dp[0][d] = 1;
        hp[0].mark[0] = true;
        md[0] = hp[0];

        // Build md[0] by merging hp[i]
        for (int i = 1; i < d; i++) {
            hp[i].dp[d][d] = 2;
            hp[i].dp[d][i] = -1;
            hp[i].dp[i][d] = 1;
            hp[i].mark[i] = true;
            md[0].mrg(hp[i]);
            hp[i] = md[0];
        }

        // Build md for subsequent indices
        for (int i = 1; i <= sizeV; i++) {
            md[i] = new Node();
            md[i] = md[i - 1];
            ht = md[i - 1];
            for (int j = 1; j < d; j++) {
                ht.shift(1);
                md[i].mrg(ht);
            }
        }

        Node ans = get((int) v.get(sizeV - 1));
        System.out.println(ans.dp[d][d]);
    }
}
